caption: The drawing depicts a single glass bottle positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The bottle is cylindrical with gently sloping shoulders leading to a short, narrow neck topped by a thick, rounded lip. The glass appears to be a muted greenish-brown, with visible gradients suggesting the thickness and transparency of the material. There are subtle highlights and reflections on the surface of the bottle, as well as some dark speckles and irregularities that give the appearance of aged or imperfect glass. The base of the bottle is slightly darker, with an area that looks like a shadow or inner residue. The composition features no additional objects or elements, and the ample negative space emphasizes the solitary bottle.
title: Shoe Blacking Bottle
